_README: Metal-silicate partitioning ledger for core oxygen provenance. Exchange coefficient log10 K_D = a + b/T + c*P/T (T in K, P in GPa), Fischer et al. 2015 GCA 167. O via the Frost 2010 exchange K_D(O)=X_O^met*X_Fe^met/X_FeO^sil. Every number sourced; paywalled coefficients flagged.

exchange_coefficients._form: log10 K_D = a + b/T + c*P/T (T in K, P in GPa); Fischer 2015 Table 2 (Eq.2). Table 3 (Eq.3) adds epsilon compositional terms for V,Cr,Si,O.

table2.sd_source: Fischer 2015 Table 2 1-sigma; full variance-covariance from supplement Table A.8 (diagonals sqrt to the 1-sigma above)

Si.c_note: blank in Table; Si nearly P-independent -> c=0

table2.sd_source: Fischer 2015 Table 2 1-sigma; full variance-covariance from supplement Table A.7 (c fixed at 0, not fitted)

_epsilon_usage: The per-element eps_O/eps_Si/eps_C above ARE the Fischer 2015 Table 3 interaction parameters e_i^k at Tref=1873 K (columns e^i_O, e^i_Si, e^i_C). Scaled to temperature by Eq (4): eps_k^i(T) = e_k^i*Mi*Tref/0.242/T - Mi/55.85 + 1, with Mi the molar mass of element i. Fed into Eq (3) for the Table-3+epsilon model. Table 2 (composition-free) fits live in each element's table2 block. Fischer's headline 1.6 wt% O uses Table 2, not the epsilon model; the bare Table-3 a/b/c are corrected-to-zero-light-element values and must not be used without the epsilon terms.

silicate_model._form: BSE major-oxide silicate melt. The four non-FeO majors are held in fixed BSE ratios and renormalized to (100 - FeO wt%) as the mantle FeO scan variable moves. Component mole fractions on a full-oxide basis give X_FeO and X_SiO2 for the exchange equilibria.
silicate_model.source: McDonough & Sun 1995; McDonough 2003 (pyrolite bulk silicate Earth)

frost_activity_model._form: Non-ideal FeO/Fe activities for the oxygen fugacity. Subregular Margules; W in J/mol, T in K, P in BAR (P_bar = 10000 * P_GPa). Metal gamma_Fe = exp((1-X_Fe)^2 [W_Fe_FeO + 2(W_FeO_Fe - W_Fe_FeO) X_Fe] / RT); silicate gamma_FeO = exp((1-X_FeO)^2 W_FeO_MgO / RT). a = X * gamma feeds Fischer Eq (1) dIW = 2 log10(a_FeO_sil / a_Fe_met).
frost_activity_model.validation: reproduces Fischer's +0.4-log fO2 shift: dIW -2.26 -> -1.80 at 54 GPa, 3350 K
frost_activity_model.caveat: Frost's system is Fe-FeO metal / FeO-MgO magnesiowustite; applying gamma_FeO(mw) to BSE silicate X_FeO and the Fe-FeO binary gamma_Fe to the Fe-O-Si metal are documented approximations.

equilibration_anchor.matches: Ni log K_D = 0.30, Co = 0.26 at IW-2

mantle_FeO.note: Badro 2015: mantle FeO ~20-25% early, falling to ~6-8% as O swept to core
mantle_FeO.source: Badro 2015 PNAS; Fischer 2015; present-day BSE 8.05 McDonough & Sun 1995

mantle_magma_prediction._form: Mass balance: the oxygen in the core came from mantle FeO, so a given core O content fixes how much FeO the mantle lost (FeO_removed = O_core * M_FeO/M_O) and hence the pre-core mantle FeO. The leftover present-day mantle FeO then predicts erupted basalt FeO via a mild melting enrichment. Falsifiable against Badro's oxidized-early-mantle range and observed MORB.
mantle_magma_prediction.core_mass_frac_source: core is 32.5 wt% of Earth (standard Earth model / PREM mass distribution)
mantle_magma_prediction.D_FeO_source: FeO mildly incompatible in mantle melting; bulk solid/melt ~0.8 (olivine+pyroxene residue)
mantle_magma_prediction.observed_MORB_source: Gale et al. 2013 G-cubed, mean ocean-ridge basalt FeO_total

mantle_liquidus._form: First-order cryoscopic (ideal freezing-point) depression of the mantle liquidus by FeO, anchored to the Ni/Co-pinned BSE liquidus. 1/T_L = 1/T_L0 - (R/dHfus)*ln((1-X_FeO)/(1-X_FeO0)), X_FeO on the full-oxide basis, X_FeO0 the BSE value. dHfus is the effective molar fusion enthalpy of the mantle liquidus assemblage, carried as a sensitivity parameter.
mantle_liquidus.T_L0_source: Andrault et al. 2011 mantle liquidus at 54 GPa, the Ni/Co-pinned single-stage temperature (Fischer et al. 2015)
mantle_liquidus.dHfus_source: effective silicate fusion enthalpy, order of forsterite/enstatite (Richet & Bottinga 1986); first-order estimate, reported with a sensitivity band

core_O_target_wt_pct.note: from the companion Fe-Ni-Si-O-C-S core composition study (high end of Badro 2.7-5)

effective_KD_targets.note: Earth's effective values Fischer matches at 54 GPa, 3350 K
